violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell eggs were stored over cooked chicken cashu in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC moved the eggs during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap at the handwashing sink behind the upstairs bar. The bar is not frequently used but must still be properly supplied.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. Jinya Ramen Bar (Inspection Date: 03/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There are no paper towels at the hand sink in the upstairs bar. The bar is not frequently used, but must remain properly stocked at all times.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected history during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: the parasite destruction would are provided to not address individual types of fish. The establishment serves raw tuna and salmon. Salmon is farm-raised and pellet-fed.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. Please obtain an updated parasite destruction letter from your provider that specifies the fish they sell you and you serve raw and under cooked. This must be corrected within three days.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: in use spoons were stored in 69º standing water on the cook line. A ladle was stored in 86º water on the griddle. Bar utensils were stored in standing 60º water in the dipperwell at the bar with the dipperwell faucet not turned on.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Discontinue storing utensils in standing water unless the water is 135º and above at all times. Discontinue storing bar tools in standing water at the dipper well with the faucet turned off. The PIC corrected all these issues during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Cannot Exceed 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is being used as a control was not cooked, served or discarded by the expiration time as indicated: there was one container of sliced cooked chicken and one container of sliced cooked pork at the soup preparation area, which did not have stickers on them to indicate when the four hours TPHC expired.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours is used as the public health control : 1) the food shall have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature or, 2) the food shall have an initial temperature of 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 3) the food shall be marked I mean or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 4) the food shall be cooked and served, served if ready to eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 5) the food if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit shall be discarded. The manager discarded both containers of food.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: there were several squeeze bottle containers of sauces and dressings, which were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Correct before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Correct before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. Unused mops were not being hung to air dry.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. Correct by the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed open employee drinking cup on the top shelf at the back kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC discarded the drinking employee’s cup. PIC will train employees on the proper use of drinking cups during operational hours.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cook line being used for washing dishes.
violations.corrective_action: Handsink are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC trained employees on proper procedures, emphasizing the importance of using designated sinks for handwashing and dishwashing.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink in the upstairs bar area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC placed soap at the hand sink.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Observed the sanitizing solution in the kitchen dish machine with a concentration of <10 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC primed the sanitizing solution to ensure that the dish machine’s chlorine/bleach concentration reached a minimum of 50-200ppm.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed garlic and oil at 71 F on cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC put garlic and oil on Time as Public Health Control.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. PIC will trained staff on proper procedures regarding wearing jewelry.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed utensils stored in water at 70F throughout the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed, cleaned and sanitized utensils.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the mop sink equipped with unapproved splitter on the thread of the faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC ordered the hydro systems pressure bleed dual valve.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps on the ceiling panels around electrical wires in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Please, seal the gaps around the electrical wires in the dry storage before the next routine inspection.
